description: This file defines a static class StringEncodedWriteVector that provides methods for manipulating a string-encoded bit vector representing replica states in an event sourcing system. It includes methods to get the state of a replica's bit and to toggle that bit.

classes.name: StringEncodedWriteVector
classes.description: A static class providing utility methods for encoding and decoding replica bit vectors as strings.

methods.name: GetBit
methods.description: Returns whether the specified replica's bit is set (true) or not (false) in the write vector string.

methods.name: FlipBit
methods.description: Toggles the bit for a specified replica in the write vector string and returns the new state.
